articles.title_en: A third Russian region declares high alert over fuel crisis — a status that allows elections to be postponed
articles.lead_en: Penza Governor Oleg Melnichenko declared a state of high alert in the region on June 30, citing the fuel crisis. Melnichenko said the measure was needed to keep emergency response services and socially significant facilities — including the fuel and energy sector — running without interruption.
